in_marathi.name: Banajit
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Banana tree victorious
in_marathi.long_meaning: Banajit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Banajit is derived from Sanskrit. It is a combination of the words 'bana' meaning 'banana tree' and 'jit' meaning 'victorious'. This name was given to a warrior who won a battle under a banana tree.
